name: KanoonAI retrieval gold set v1
purpose: One fixed batch used to tune retrieval parameters. Queries are written the way our actual users write - short, worried, sometimes ungrammatical, sometimes Hinglish, rarely using the correct legal term. A retrieved chunk counts as relevant only if it comes from the expected Act AND the expected section, so a run cannot be gamed by returning the right Act's table of contents.

batch.query: someone gave me a cheque and it bounced what can i do
cheque bounce ho gaya hai mera paisa kaise milega
landlord is not giving back my security deposit after i left the house
the other party broke our agreement, can i get money for my loss
i worked 6 years in company will i get gratuity
how many months leave i can take for having baby
how do i ask government office for information
my husband beats me what order can court give to stop him

relevant.act: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act 2005

batch.query: my manager is harassing me at office how do i complain

relevant.act: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act 2013

batch.query: truck hit my father on road, how to claim money
i have no money for lawyer can i get free one
batch.note: S.12 sets the criteria for free legal aid, S.13 the entitlement; either answers the question.
